card.name: Driving directions continuing onward
card.fires_on: Words and punctuation in road directions right after a turn or street name, where the next words tell the reader to keep going along the route (continue, keep going, follow the road).

modes.label: Continue instruction
modes.description: The word Continue or keep going at the start of the next step of route directions.
modes.example: Turn right on Market Street, which later becomes Elliott Island Road.<< Continue>> south until you reach the edge of the

modes.label: Punctuation after a turn
modes.description: A period, comma or 'and' after a turn or street name, just before a keep-going instruction.
modes.example: Turn left at the small village called Baraing,<< and>> follow the dirt road through the rice fields

modes.label: Distance travelled
modes.description: A distance unit in a travel description that leads on to the next place.
modes.example: Traveling some 10<<km>>, they will reach Oc Eo Township

card.writes: It pushes toward words meaning further on, such as beyond and ahead.
card.plain: It marks spots in route directions where the text is about to say keep going further along the road.
